Samir / Elena / Logan — quick tech/legal notes from our side before the workshop: 

1) Signatory & DocuSign: I will be the signatory for the Master DPA on behalf of Redwood (Kimberly Park, Senior Counsel, Privacy). We will send the DocuSign envelope that bundles: the Master DPA redline, the SOW, and the PO attachment slot. Expect the envelope id in the calendar invite email.

2) HSM / KMS: Our HSM provider (FortressKey Solutions) is listed in the CSV; they provide key custody only — Redwood does not share raw keys. I’ll include their SOC2 link and a short attestation in the matrix.

3) Pilot buffer controls: we can confirm the three controls Samir requested: audit logging per buffer access, an immutable TTL enforcement (enforced by infra, not ops), and a rollback procedure with automated purge. We’ll document the control owners and the proof artifacts (log samples, TTL config snippets) in uk-addendum-evidence-matrix.xlsx.

4) TIA sequencing: recommended sequencing — run the evidence sprint (collect proofs), legal reviews DPA redline in parallel, procurement signs PO once DocuSign completed, then production pilot (with buffer enabled) after a final go/no-go checklist. This will help avoid blocking the procurement signature on item-level evidence that can be delivered post-signing under contractual milestones.

5) Data classification note: session prefix/KV cache is considered transient workload metadata; we will annotate it in the matrix as non-personal persistent storage but will surface encryption and access logs for your audit.

If Nov 9 (14:00–16:00 UK) works I’ll block the time and circulate the DocuSign envelope + a short pre-read (evidence matrix draft).
